QuestInfo.name: [Vampire Season] Hunter of the Night
QuestInfo.0: This woman has a story, judging by her forlorn look and formidable weapons.
QuestInfo.1: She was the Dark King's childhood friend. When they were human they were in love, but everything changed when the Bloody Queen seduced him. Now she hunts vampires, and will reward you for curing the infection with the Blood Cure 30 times.
